start: Member app, Help and feedback, signed in to a gym, AI answers on

steps.action: Type a question about the app and send it
user_sees: A short answer written from the help articles
'Did this solve it?' with Yes and No
must_not: The message lost when the AI is slow
An answer that names another gym or member

steps.action: Tap Yes
user_sees: The answer stays; the tap is kept once
must_not: A second rating saved for the same question

start: Member app, the gym has no AI credits left (or the member's AI questions for today are used up)

steps.action: Send a question
user_sees: The matching help pages, with a line saying why the AI was not asked
No AI answer
must_not: An AI call charged to the gym
An error in place of the help pages

steps.action: Later, open Help and feedback again
user_sees: The team's reply under the question once HQ replies
must_not: The question missing because no AI answered it

start: Member app, Help and feedback

steps.action: Send an empty message
user_sees: 'Write something first.'
must_not: An empty row saved

steps.action: Paste a message over 2000 letters and send
user_sees: 'Keep it under 2000 letters.'
must_not: The text saved cut short without a word

steps.action: Send a 21st message within 24 hours
user_sees: 'Too many messages today. Try again tomorrow.'
must_not: An AI call made for a refused message

start: Member app, a question already answered by the AI

steps.action: Tap No on "Did this solve it?"
user_sees: The tap kept; the question goes to the HQ team to reply
must_not: The question marked solved

steps.action: Try to rate the same question again (or from another phone)
user_sees: 'Not found.' refused; the first rating stays
must_not: The rating changed or a second one saved

steps.action: Open Help and feedback after the team replied twice
user_sees: Both team replies, oldest first
must_not: Only the newest reply, with the first lost

start: Member app, a question that names a body problem

steps.action: Send the question
user_sees: An answer from the help articles only
must_not: The AI shown the member's gym record, gym code, install id or phone model

steps.action: Another phone that knows this install's id asks for the replies without the question's secret
user_sees: Nothing (an empty list)
must_not: The member's question, the AI answer or the team's reply handed out

start: Admin app, Help and feedback, signed in as the owner

steps.action: Type a question and send it
user_sees: A short answer from the help articles
'Did this solve it?'
must_not: A credit taken for the owner's own question

steps.action: Tap Yes
user_sees: The tap is kept
must_not: The question shown to the gym's members

start: Admin app, the monthly AI ceiling is reached (or the AI key is missing)

steps.action: Send a question
user_sees: 'Thanks! We read every message and reply as soon as we can.'
must_not: The message lost
An error screen

steps.action: Open Help and feedback the next day
user_sees: The team's reply when HQ has answered
must_not: The reply shown on another owner's device

start: Admin app, the owner's daily free questions are used up

steps.action: Send another question
user_sees: The matching help pages, with a line about the daily limit and a way to get credits
must_not: An AI call made anyway
A blank answer

steps.action: Send an empty message
user_sees: 'Write something first.'
must_not: An empty question saved

start: Admin app, an answered question

steps.action: Tap No
user_sees: The question waits for the HQ team
must_not: The question shown as solved

steps.action: After the HQ reply, open the question
user_sees: The team's reply under the AI answer
must_not: The No rating lost

start: Admin app, a question that names a member

steps.action: Send the question
user_sees: An answer from the help articles only
must_not: Any of the gym's member records sent to the AI
The sign-in key saved or sent to the AI

start: Admin app, Help and feedback, signed in as front desk staff

steps.action: Type a question and send it
user_sees: A short answer from the help articles
'Did this solve it?'
must_not: A gym credit taken for the staff question

start: Admin app, staff member's daily free questions used up

steps.action: Send another question
user_sees: The matching help pages and a line about the daily limit
must_not: An AI call made
An error

steps.action: Send 21 messages in a day from the same browser
user_sees: 'Too many messages today. Try again tomorrow.'
must_not: The 21st saved

start: Admin app, an answered staff question

steps.action: Tap Yes, then try to tap No
user_sees: Only the first tap kept
must_not: The rating flipped

start: Trainer signed in to the admin app, Help and feedback

steps.action: Send a question about member questions
user_sees: An answer from the help articles about who reads questions
must_not: A gym credit taken
Feedback or a complaint of a member shown

start: Trainer, Help and feedback

steps.action: Send an empty message
user_sees: 'Write something first.'
must_not: An empty row saved

steps.action: Send after the daily free questions are used
user_sees: The matching help pages, no AI
must_not: An error with no answer

start: Trainer, an answered question

steps.action: Tap No, then wait for the team
user_sees: The team's reply appears under the question
must_not: The question lost after the app is reopened on the same device

start: HQ feedback list, a member question the AI could not cover

steps.action: Open the feedback list
user_sees: The question with its AI answer marked as needing a reply
must_not: Questions the AI covered and the person marked solved shown as needing a reply

steps.action: Write a reply and send it
user_sees: The question no longer needs a reply
must_not: The reply saved on another question

steps.action: The member opens Help and feedback
user_sees: The team's reply under the question
must_not: The reply readable by any other install

start: HQ feedback list

steps.action: Look for crash rows and spam among questions needing a reply
user_sees: Crash, done and spam rows never in the needs-reply list
must_not: A crash row offered for a reply

start: HQ feedback list, a question the AI covered

steps.action: The person taps No
user_sees: The question comes back as needing a reply
must_not: It stays hidden as solved

steps.action: Reply 21 times to one question
user_sees: The newest 20 replies kept
must_not: The list growing without limit

start: HQ feedback list

steps.action: Read one question
user_sees: The text, which app, the screen name and the app version
must_not: The gym code, install id or phone model sent to the AI
A member record shown beside it
